name: Emmet
description: Type abbreviations like div.card>h2+p and press Tab to expand full HTML/CSS instantly.
activationCode: (function startEmmet() { function checkAndInit() { var emmet = window.emmetMonaco || (window.emmetMonacoEs && window.emmetMonacoEs.default) || window.emmet; var monacoObj = window.monaco || (window.editor && window.editor.monaco); if (emmet && monacoObj) { try { if (typeof emmet.emmetHTML === 'function') { emmet.emmetHTML(monacoObj); emmet.emmetCSS(monacoObj); } } catch(err) {} } else { setTimeout(checkAndInit, 300); } } checkAndInit(); })();

name: Python Offline Runner (Pyodide)
description: Run Python code 100% offline inside your browser using WebAssembly. Includes basic syntax suggestions.
activationCode: (async function initPythonRunner() { if (window.loadPyodide && !window.pyodideInstance) { try { window.pyodideInstance = await loadPyodide(); console.log('[Python Extension] Pyodide loaded successfully offline.'); } catch(e) { console.error('[Python Init Error]', e); } } })();
